import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # Source2_24_0: ['user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # Source2_24_1: ['movie_id', 'title']

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_24_0 and Source2_24_1 on "movie_id"
joined_df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source2_24_1.title with aggregations:
# count(Source2_24_0.rating) as size, avg(Source2_24_0.rating) as mean
grouped = joined_df.groupby("title").agg(
    size=pd.NamedAgg(column="rating", aggfunc="count"),
    mean=pd.NamedAgg(column="rating", aggfunc="mean")
).reset_index()

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# ['title': string, 'size': integer, 'mean': float]
grouped["title"] = grouped["title"].astype(str)
grouped["size"] = grouped["size"].astype(int)
grouped["mean"] = grouped["mean"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_24_0 and Source2_24_1 on movie_id
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='movie_id', right_on='movie_id')

# Group by title and aggregate count of rating as size and average of rating as mean
result = joined.groupby('title', as_index=False).agg(
    size=('rating', 'count'),
    mean=('rating', 'mean')
)

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
result = result[['title', 'size', 'mean']]

# Write output to the specified file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
